title: Isaiah's Vision and Israel's Covenant
english: Book 2. The vision that Isaiah son of Amos saw concerning Babylon. The vision concerning Babylon, and indeed those following it, concerning Edom and Moab, and indeed Egypt, and others, were made for the encouragement of Israel.

The historical aspects have a certain interpretation, except for those with understanding, as from thick and now image to recontextualize into spiritual contemplation what happened to the ancients most clearly.
The word will make the narration for those who are present, and interpreting each of the written things as if it were now.
I think it is necessary now to return to the beginning of the matter and to narrate the causes of the vision.

For Israel, called by the all-wise Moses, was led into knowledge and worship of the true God, and having a law that directs toward every thing marveled, he neglected his own commandment, turned to human teachings, and more so plunged himself into the pits of idolatry.
Therefore, the God of all things condemned such actions through every prophet, and greatly lamented his disobedience.
This people draws near to me with their mouth and honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me (Isaiah 29:13). What has the beloved done in my house, an abomination? (Isaiah 29:13)

Therefore, having been driven away terribly into exiles, and bearing the neck of the slavery under God, and raising a harshness as their own against him, you delivered according to times, sometimes to those who take the neighbor's land, I mean the Edomites, and also the Moabites, Egyptians, and those from Philistia, sometimes also bringing a harsher plague upon them, those who are most cruel to them, I mean the Babylonians, who even completely devastated the land of the Jews, took captive into their greater multitude.
But these things, that will happen, they provoke the God of all to them, the blessed prophets foretold according to times.
But even those who have gone beyond them in the already foretold, nothing less…
